meaning: SHA256 integrity is not a digital signature or a proof of functional correctness. The local private configured directory may contain .local; distributable archives never do.
optionalAssets: Playwright recorder/trace-viewer icon fonts are omitted. Headless browser automation and the application UI do not need them.
relocation: Before installation use --verify. Installation regenerates Python entrypoints and paths; afterward --verify --installed reports those exceptions explicitly and checks the remainder.
